reason: A proposes a specific, physically plausible Al–Ni/Co-driven BCC-to-B2 ordering/partitioning mechanism, with defined thermal conditions, a quenched baseline, measurable superlattice and chemical-order signatures, and a decisive falsification test. B is comparatively generic and partly inconsistent in invoking limited diffusion at high temperature, while leaving the secondary phases and thermodynamic instability insufficiently specified.
